params.name: roomId
params.description: Unique identifier for the room to list messages from.

params.name: parentId
params.description: List messages that are replies to the specified parent message.

params.name: mentionedPeople
params.description: List messages where the specified person is mentioned. Use 'me' for the authenticated user.

params.name: before
params.description: List messages sent before a date and time in ISO 8601 format.

params.name: beforeMessage
params.description: List messages sent before a specified message ID.

params.name: max
params.description: Maximum number of messages to return (default 50, max 1000).

items.docs: Lists all messages in a room. Each message includes content and metadata about the message. The list sorts the messages in descending order by creation date.
Posts a plain text, rich text, or card message to a room. Messages can include file attachments and adaptive cards. The files parameter is limited to one file per message.

params.name: personId
params.description: Person ID of the other participant in the direct conversation.

params.name: personEmail
params.description: Email address of the other participant in the direct conversation.

items.docs: Lists all messages in a 1:1 (direct) room with another person. The authenticated user must be a member of the direct conversation.
Shows details for a message by message ID. Specify the message ID in the URI. The returned message includes all content and metadata.
Updates a message you have posted. Supports editing plain text and markdown content. Cannot edit messages with files or attachments. Maximum of 10 edits per message.
Deletes a message by message ID. The deleted message will no longer be visible in the room. Moderators can delete any message; others can only delete their own.
